. P. (इच्छति, इयेष, ऐषीत्, एषितुम्-एष्टुम्, इष्ट) 
__1 To wish, desire, long for; इच्छामि संवर्धितमाज्ञया ते [[

]]; oft. with pot. or imperat. mood; इच्छामि भुञ्जीत or भुङ्क्तां भबान्; भुञ्जीयेतीच्छति [[Sk.]] 
__2 To choose; मूत्रेण मौण्ड्यमिच्छेत् तु क्षत्रियो दण्डमेब वा [[

.]] 
__3 To endeavour to obtain, strive or seek for; भूतिमिच्छता, स्वर्गम् &c. 
__4 To be willing, be about to do anything, mean or intend (with. inf.). [Page0389-2] 
__5 To ask or expect anything (acc.) from any one (loc. or abl.); देवेषु यज्ञे भागमीषिरे [[Śat. Br.]] 
__6 To acknowledge, regard. 
__7 To request, ask. 
__8 To be favourable. 
__9 To try to make favourable. 
__10 To assent or consent. -pass. 
__1 To be wished or liked. 
__2 To be asked, or requested. 
__3 To be prescribed or laid down; हस्तच्छेदनमिष्यते [[

.]] 
__4 To be approved, accepted, or regarded as जम्भो दन्तेऽपि चेष्यते [[Trik.]] --

P. (इष्यति इयेष एषिष्यति, एषितुम्) 
__1 To move; to cause to move; केनेषितं पतति प्रेषितं मनः [[

.]] 
__2 To let fly, cast, throw. 
__3 To raise (as one's voice). 
__4 To sprinkle. --

P. (इष्णाति) 
__1 To cause to move quickly, let fly, cast. 
__2 To fly off, escape. 
__3 To strike, smite; न वेद खं गां च परिश्रमेषितः [[

.]] 
__4 To impel, urge, incite, animate, promote. 
__5 To perform frequently; इष्णाति वैष्णवो व्रतम् --

a. 
__1 Speedy, going quickly. 
__2 Wishing, desirous. f. Ved. 
__1 A draught, refreshment, food; वनस्पतीनोषधीश्च ससर्जोर्जमिषं विभुः [[

.]] 
__2 Libation; नम ऊर्ज इषे त्रय्याः पतये यज्ञरेतसे [[

.]] 
__3 Strength, power, sap, freshness. 
__4 Comfort; increase. 
__5 Affluence. 
__6 Refreshing waters of the sky. 
__7 Wish.
ind. An interjection of anger, pain, or sorrow.
€2Ā. (ईष्टे, ईशाञ्चके, ऐशिष्ट, ईशिता, ईशितुम्, ईशित) 1 To rule, be master of, govern, command (with gen.); नायं गात्राणामीष्टे [[
]] v. l.; अर्थानामीशिषे त्वं वयमपि च गिरामीश्महे यावदर्थम् [[

.]] 
__1 (also used in the Veda with gen. of an infinitive or loc. of an abstract noun). 
__2 To be able, have power; expressed by 'can'; माधुयर्मीष्टे हरिणान् ग्रहीतुम् [[

.]] 
__3 To act like a master, allow. 
__4 To own, possess. 
__5 To belong to.
m. A master, lord, the Supreme Spirit. ईशावास्यमिदं सर्वम् [[Īśop. 1.]]

€1U. (ईषति-ते, ऐषीत्, ईषितुम्, ईषित) 
__1 To fly away escape. 
__2 To creep along. 
__3 To glean, collect a few grains. 
__4 To look, see. 
__5 To give. 
__6 To attack, hurt, kill.
